training_modules.title: Cappuccino Preparation
training_modules.description: Complete operational guide for grinding, extracting espresso, steaming milk, and serving standard café cappuccinos.

sop_json.title: Cappuccino Preparation
sop_json.summary: Standard operating procedure for preparing and serving a consistent, high-quality artisanal cappuccino for café guests.
prerequisites: Completed basic café safety and hygiene induction
Espresso machine warmed up to operating pressure (9 bar)
materials: Clean microfiber cloth for steam wand

steps.title: Hygiene & Machine Preparation
steps.instructions: Thoroughly wash and sanitize hands with warm water and soap for 20 seconds. Inspect the espresso group head and run a 2-second blank water flush to clear residual coffee oils.
steps.expected_outcome: Hands are sanitized and group head is clean and pre-warmed for brewing.
warnings: Group head and shower screen are extremely hot (93°C). Do not touch directly with bare hands.
common_mistakes: Skipping the blank water flush, which causes stale coffee taste.

steps.title: Dosing and Grinding Coffee Beans
steps.instructions: Remove the portafilter, wipe the basket dry with a clean cloth. Grind exactly 18.0 grams of fresh coffee beans directly into the portafilter basket.
steps.expected_outcome: Dry basket filled with 18g clump-free espresso coffee grounds.
warnings: Moisture in the portafilter basket leads to channeling and bitter espresso.
common_mistakes: Grinding too far in advance, resulting in oxidized coffee.

steps.title: Tamping and Espresso Extraction
steps.instructions: Level the coffee grounds gently. Hold the tamper perpendicular and press firmly with approximately 15 kg of even pressure. Lock portafilter firmly into group head and immediately begin extraction. Extract 36ml of double espresso in 25 to 30 seconds.
steps.expected_outcome: A rich double espresso shot with dense golden-hazelnut crema.
warnings: Do not bang the portafilter after tamping, as this cracks the coffee puck.
common_mistakes: Uneven tamping causing fast watery flow under 20 seconds.

steps.title: Milk Steaming and Microfoam Creation
steps.instructions: Pour 150 ml of cold milk (4°C) into the stainless steel pitcher. Purge steam wand for 1 second. Submerge wand tip 1 cm below milk surface at an angle to create a whirlpool vortex. Stretch milk until warm to touch, then submerge slightly deeper until thermometer reads 60–65°C.
steps.expected_outcome: Silky, glossy microfoam resembling wet paint with no large bubbles.
warnings: Never heat milk above 70°C as proteins burn and create bitter, sour flavors. Steam wand burns skin quickly.
common_mistakes: Holding steam wand too deep early on, causing heated flat milk without foam.

steps.title: Pouring and Cup Integration
steps.instructions: Swirl and tap the pitcher on the counter to settle foam. Slowly pour steamed milk into the center of the espresso shot from a height of 5 cm to integrate milk and crema, then lower the spout close to the surface to finish with a clean white foam circle or latte art.
steps.expected_outcome: Harmonious drink balance of 1/3 espresso, 1/3 steamed milk, and 1/3 velvety microfoam.
warnings: Pour slowly to avoid splashing hot liquid on hands or counter.
common_mistakes: Dumping milk too fast, breaking the golden crema ring.

steps.title: Steam Wand Cleaning and Station Sanitization
steps.instructions: Immediately wipe the steam wand with a dedicated damp microfiber cloth. Purge steam wand for 2 seconds to blow out internal milk residue. Knock out used coffee puck and rinse portafilter.
steps.expected_outcome: Pristine steam wand free of baked milk crust and tidy barista station.
warnings: Always point steam wand down into the drip tray when purging to prevent steam burns.
common_mistakes: Delaying wand wiping, causing milk to bake onto wand and breed bacteria.

steps.title: Service and Customer Confirmation
steps.instructions: Place the cappuccino cup on a clean saucer with a teaspoon and brown sugar sachet. Serve to customer with a smile within 60 seconds of preparation. Warmly confirm order: "Here is your fresh Cappuccino, enjoy!"
steps.expected_outcome: Delighted customer receiving hot, fresh coffee with verified order accuracy.
warnings: Ensure saucer base is dry to avoid cup sliding.
common_mistakes: Letting cup sit on counter until foam collapses.

completion_checklist: Espresso extracted between 25-30s with rich crema
Milk steamed between 60-65°C with silky microfoam
Steam wand wiped and purged immediately
Served hot with clean saucer and smile

questions.question: What is the correct dose of coffee beans for preparing a standard double espresso shot?
questions.explanation: According to Step 2 of the SOP, exactly 18.0 grams of fresh coffee beans should be ground into the portafilter basket.

questions.question: What is the ideal extraction time window for 36ml of double espresso?
questions.explanation: Step 3 states that 36ml of double espresso should be extracted in 25 to 30 seconds for optimal flavor extraction.

questions.question: What is the target temperature range when steaming milk for a cappuccino?
questions.explanation: Step 4 specifies steaming cold milk to 60–65°C to create sweet, velvety microfoam without scorching milk proteins.

questions.question: Why must you immediately wipe and purge the steam wand after steaming milk?
options: To look busy in front of customers
To prevent milk from baking onto wand and blowing out internal residue
To cool down the coffee machine quickly
questions.explanation: Step 6 highlights wiping immediately to prevent milk crust from baking onto hot metal and purging to blow out any milk sucked into the wand tip.

questions.question: Within how many seconds should a fresh cappuccino be served to the customer?
questions.explanation: Step 7 specifies serving the cappuccino within 60 seconds to ensure the customer receives hot coffee before the delicate microfoam begins to separate.

training_versions.source_transcript:
1. Wash hands and clean the espresso machine.
2. Grind 18 grams of fresh coffee beans.
3. Tamp the coffee evenly and extract espresso for 25–30 seconds.
4. Steam 150 ml of cold milk to 60–65°C, creating smooth microfoam.
5. Pour milk slowly into the espresso.
6. Wipe the steam wand and clean the machine after use.
7. Serve immediately and confirm the customer order.

sop_json.title: कॅप्युचिनो बनवण्याची कार्यपद्धती (SOP)
sop_json.summary: कॅफेमधील पाहुण्यांसाठी दर्जेदार आणि चवदार कॅप्युचिनो तयार करण्यासाठी प्रमाणित मार्गदर्शक कार्यपद्धती.
prerequisites: कॅफे स्वच्छता आणि सुरक्षा नियम समजून घेतलेले असावेत
एस्प्रेसो मशीन योग्य दाबावर (9 bar) चालू असावे

steps.title: स्वच्छता आणि मशीनची तयारी
steps.instructions: २० सेकंद साबण आणि कोमट पाण्याने हात स्वच्छ धुवा. मशीनचे ग्रुप हेड २ सेकंद फ्लश करून जुनी कॉफी साफ करा.
steps.expected_outcome: हात स्वच्छ आणि ग्रुप हेड कॉफी गाळण्यासाठी तयार.
warnings: ग्रुप हेड खूप गरम असते (९३°C), हाताने थेट स्पर्श करू नका.
common_mistakes: फ्लश न करणे, ज्यामुळे कॉफीची चव कडवट लागते.

steps.title: कॉफी बीन्स बारीक दळणे
steps.instructions: पोर्टाफिल्टर कोरड्या कापडाने पुसा. काट्यावर तंतोतंत १८ ग्रॅम ताजी कॉफी पावडर दळून घ्या.
steps.expected_outcome: १८ ग्रॅम व्यवस्थित दळलेली ताजी कॉफी पावडर.
warnings: फिल्टरमध्ये ओलावा असल्यास कॉफी खराब होते.
common_mistakes: खूप आधी दळून ठेवणे, ज्यामुळे कॉफीचा सुगंध उडतो.

steps.title: टॅम्पिंग आणि एस्प्रेसो काढणे
steps.instructions: कॉफी पावडर समान पातळीवर करा आणि १५ किलो दाबाने टँप करा. मशीनमध्ये लावून २५ ते ३० सेकंदात ३६ मिली एस्प्रेसो काढा.
steps.expected_outcome: सोनेरी रंगाची दाट फेस असलेली (Crema) एस्प्रेसो तयार होईल.
warnings: टँप केल्यावर फिल्टरवर जोरात आदळू नका.
common_mistakes: असमांतर टॅम्पिंगमुळे कॉफी पातळ आणि पाण्यासारखी निघणे.

steps.title: दूध वाफवणे (Steaming)
steps.instructions: १५० मिली थंड दूध भांड्यात घ्या. वाफेचा पाईप (Steam wand) दुधात १ सेमी बुडवून वाफ सोडा आणि तापमान ६०-६५°C पर्यंत आणा.
steps.expected_outcome: मखमली, चमकदार आणि बारीक फेस असलेले गरम दूध.
warnings: दूध ७०°C च्या वर गरम करू नका, दुधाची चव बिघडते.
common_mistakes: पाईप खूप खोल बुडवल्यास फेस तयार होत नाही.

steps.title: दूध आणि एस्प्रेसो एकत्र करणे
steps.instructions: वाफवलेले दूध ५ सेमी उंचीवरून हळूच एस्प्रेसोच्या मध्यभागी ओता आणि शेवटी सुंदर पांढरा फेस तयार करा.
steps.expected_outcome: १/३ एस्प्रेसो, १/३ गरम दूध आणि १/३ मखमली फेस असलेला संतुलित कॅप्युचिनो.
warnings: गरम दूध अंगावर उडणार नाही याची काळजी घ्या.
common_mistakes: दूध खूप वेगाने ओतल्यास क्रीम विरघळते.

steps.title: वाफेचा पाईप स्वच्छ करणे
steps.instructions: दुधाचे काम संपताच पाईप ओल्या कापडाने ताबडतोब पुसा आणि २ सेकंद वाफ सोडून आतील दूध बाहेर टाका.
steps.expected_outcome: स्वच्छ पाईप आणि निरोगी कामाची जागा.
warnings: वाफ सोडताना पाईप नेहमी खालच्या दिशेने ठेवा.
common_mistakes: पाईप न पुसल्यास दुधाचा थर जमून घाण वास येतो.

steps.title: ग्राहकाला आदराने सर्व्ह करणे
steps.instructions: कॅप्युचिनो कप सॉसरवर ठेवा, सोबत चमचा द्या. ६० सेकंदांच्या आत हसतमुखाने ग्राहकास द्या: "हा घ्या तुमचा गरमागरम कॅप्युचिनो!".
steps.expected_outcome: आनंदी ग्राहक आणि अचूक ऑर्डर सेवा.
warnings: सॉसर कोरडी असल्याची खात्री करा.
common_mistakes: कॉफी बराच वेळ काउंटरवर ठेवणे ज्यामुळे फेस बसतो.
